supersedes_without_mutating.reason: V1 correctly blocked pseudo-replication but did not define an enumerable query population, immutable GitHub lineage, externally verifiable randomization, reviewer separation, or design weights.

estimand.primary_unit: one treatment-blind planning task from one independent GitHub owner/source-lineage cluster
estimand.paired_contrast: candidate Skill revision minus baseline Skill revision on the same task
estimand.target_population: eligible post-treatment public GitHub maintenance records in the exact query-plan union
estimand.development_role: measurement development only and excluded from confirmatory inference
estimand.safety_control_role: separate zero-tolerance operational gates and never pooled into the target outcome
estimand.attempt_role: within-task repeatability; attempts never increase the independent sample size
estimand.external_validity_boundary: No inference beyond the exact query-defined GitHub population, locked Skill revisions, harness, model route, runtime, and task-authoring contract.

population.raw_record_source: the complete two-acquisition union produced by conference-query-plan-v2.json
population.shortfall_policy: fail closed and publish a new prospective protocol version before inspecting any treatment output; never add hand-picked records or reduce quotas

repository: Public, non-archived, non-disabled, non-fork repository at the acquisition snapshot.
Immutable GitHub repository REST ID, node ID, owner node ID, canonical URL, and source/fork/template lineage are recorded.
An OSI-identifiable license blob is present in the exact task source tree.
The exact source tree can be archived without gitlinks, unsafe links, unavailable LFS objects, secret-bearing paths, generated dependency trees, or executable preparation inside an Agent trial.
The repository, record, base tree, and source digest are absent from every prior Fugue task, prompt-development set, judge calibration set, and trace audit.
record: The immutable record node ID belongs to the selected repository lineage and falls inside the query-plan observation window.
A target, docs-only, or single-surface record is a merged human-authored pull request with a reachable pre-change base commit and merge result.
A no-change-required or unsafe-request control is a closed public issue with an adjudicated no-change or safety rationale and a frozen acquisition-time default-branch tree.
Dependency-only, generated-only, bot-authored, vague, embargoed, personal-data-bearing, or solution-only records are excluded.
The maintenance question is answerable by inspecting the read-only task source without network access, installation, or execution.
task: The public brief is authored from the frozen problem record and task source, is blind to treatment identity, and asks for a plan or an explicit no-plan/safety response.
The Agent-visible brief omits the pull-request URL, merged diff, expected paths, expected symbols, reference plan, reviewer labels, and private scoring contract.
The host-only label is authored from public merged or adjudication evidence by a separate reviewer and remains mode 0600.
Every task is assigned exactly one stratum before external randomness is revealed.

provenance_checks: For a pull-request task, task_commit_sha equals base_commit_sha and task_tree_sha equals the base commit's Git tree SHA.
The base repository node ID equals the selected immutable repository node ID.
The merge commit is reachable and records the selected pull request; the merged diff is host-only evaluation evidence and is absent from the task archive.
The archive expands exactly to the recursively fetched base tree manifest with no extra or missing paths.
The license blob and digest are resolved at task_commit_sha rather than inferred from the mutable default branch.

independence.repository_identity: immutable GitHub repository node ID, not URL
independence.cluster_identity: owner node ID plus source-root node ID plus template-root node ID
independence.fallback_if_cluster_quota_is_unmet: blocked; owner/source/template lineage reuse cannot be counted as an independent task

reviewer_roles.acquisition_steward: May read GitHub responses and provenance; may not author tasks, labels, or inspect treatment outputs.
reviewer_roles.eligibility_reviewers: Independently decide inclusion and stratum from frozen public evidence; may not inspect Skill-arm outputs or selection ranks.
reviewer_roles.eligibility_adjudicator: Resolves reviewer disagreements before randomness is revealed and signs the decision ledger.
reviewer_roles.public_task_author: Receives only the frozen problem record and pre-change task tree; may not inspect the merged diff, private label, or treatment output.
reviewer_roles.private_label_author: May inspect the public resolution and merged diff; may not inspect treatment outputs or modify the public task.
reviewer_roles.leakage_reviewer: Compares public tasks against private evidence, treatment names, prior tasks, and forbidden strings before sealing.
reviewer_roles.analysis_steward: Receives identities and terminal rows only after task, scorer, selection, and holdout locks are immutable.
reviewer_roles.role_overlap_policy: Acquisition and analysis administration may overlap; task author, label author, and leakage reviewer must be distinct for a task, and no reviewer may evaluate their own artifact.

external_randomness.pulse_rule: Use the first signed pulse at least 24 hours after the public GitHub population-freeze commit timestamp.
required_receipt: public population-freeze Git commit URL and SHA
external_randomness.master_seed_derivation: SHA256(UTF8(protocol_id + newline + lowercase_population_sha256 + newline + lowercase_pulse_output_hex + newline)); the lowercase 64-hex digest is the master_seed_hex.
external_randomness.domain_seed_derivation: For each literal label in domain_separated_seeds, domain_seed_hex = SHA256(UTF8(master_seed_hex + newline + label + newline)). No NUL bytes, length prefixes, Unicode normalization, or operator-provided salt are permitted.

selection_score_encoding.repository_record_pair: SHA256(UTF8(independence-cluster-choice-v2 domain_seed_hex + newline + independence_cluster_id + newline + repository_node_id + newline + record_node_id + newline))
selection_score_encoding.partition: SHA256(UTF8(partition-selection-v2 domain_seed_hex + newline + independence_cluster_id + newline + selected_record_node_id + newline))
selection_score_encoding.arm_order: SHA256(UTF8(arm-order-v2 domain_seed_hex + newline + stable_attempt_id + newline + arm_id + newline))
selection_score_encoding.ordering: ascending lowercase hexadecimal digest with the final stable identifier as the deterministic collision tie-break
selection_score_encoding.claim: These byte formulas prospectively amend ambiguous prose elsewhere in this V2 protocol and are authoritative before any population or beacon is frozen.

external_randomness.missing_or_invalid_pulse_policy: fail closed; do not substitute local randomness or a later operator-selected pulse

selection.record_choice: Within each immutable repository node ID and final stratum, select the eligible record with the smallest SHA256(record-choice seed || newline || record node ID || newline).
selection.cluster_choice: Within each owner/source/template independence cluster and final stratum, select the repository-record pair with the smallest domain-separated cluster score.
selection.partition_order: Within each stratum, sort surviving independent clusters by SHA256(partition-selection seed || newline || cluster ID || newline || record node ID || newline).
selection.allocation: For each target stratum, ranks 1-8 are development and 9-56 are sealed holdout. For each safety-control stratum, ranks 1-16 are sealed controls.
selection.replacement: No post-output replacement. A pre-execution immutable-source failure invalidates the frame version rather than advancing to an unregistered alternate.
selection.selection_receipt: Publish every eligible cluster score and rank, not only the selected rows.

population_weighting.primary_estimand: design-weighted mean paired candidate-minus-baseline effect across the eligible query-defined target population
population_weighting.stratum_population_count: N_h is the frozen number of eligible independent clusters after deterministic record and cluster choice in target stratum h
population_weighting.holdout_sample_count: n_h equals 48 for each target stratum
population_weighting.analysis_weight: w_h = N_h / n_h, normalized across the 192 target holdouts
population_weighting.development_weight: none; development rows are excluded from confirmatory estimates
population_weighting.safety_control_weight: none; safety controls are reported as separate gates
population_weighting.equal_stratum_sensitivity: Report an unweighted equal-stratum estimate only as a preregistered sensitivity analysis.
population_weighting.missing_weight_policy: A missing, nonfinite, or recomputed-disagreeing weight invalidates confirmatory analysis.

task_authoring_and_leakage.manual_check: A leakage reviewer signs every task after seeing both views and before private labels are sealed mode 0600.
task_authoring_and_leakage.leak_or_contamination_policy: Invalidate the frame before execution; never rewrite an exposed holdout in place.

raw_public_data_privacy.storage: Acquisition directories are mode 0700 and raw response, candidate, and receipt files are mode 0600; symbolic-link targets are rejected.
raw_public_data_privacy.scan_boundary: A pinned credential-pattern scanner records only pattern IDs, affected immutable record IDs, response digests, and JSON paths. Matched values are never copied into a receipt, review ledger, task, trace, or report.
raw_public_data_privacy.affected_record_policy: A token-shaped or private-value finding blocks the record from task authoring and export until a separately digested reviewer decision excludes it or a sanitized derivative is created without modifying the immutable raw source.

preparation.trusted_boundary: All GitHub reads, review ledgers, source archiving, license resolution, task authoring, task-image construction, and digest generation occur in setup --prepare before preview.
preparation.task_runtime: One digest-verified read-only pre-change archive and one public task; no merged diff or GitHub metadata endpoint is available.

sealing.development: A separate exact development Study preview may open only the 32 development tasks after all 288 tasks are frozen.
sealing.holdout: The 192 target holdouts and 64 safety controls remain inaccessible until development analysis is frozen and a separate exact holdout preview is approved.

analysis.primary_unit: independent owner/source/template cluster task mean over valid repeated attempts
analysis.primary_model: design-weighted paired candidate-minus-baseline estimator with cluster-respecting uncertainty
analysis.power: Recompute prospectively from the complete frozen frame, observed N_h, planned attempts, conservative discordance assumptions, and any remaining higher-order cluster design effect before holdout preview.
analysis.multiplicity: Holm across the three repository-level campaign hypotheses; dimension-level families remain secondary within repository.
analysis.safety: Critical failures and safety controls are zero-tolerance gates, not positive outcome points.
analysis.judge: A same-model-family judge remains advisory until independently reviewed calibration and validation pass; deterministic and human-reviewed outcomes remain separate.
analysis.trace_audit: Inspect every discordant task, every critical failure, and a preregistered stratified sample of concordant tasks with exact Agent, Skill-use, scorer, cost, and cleanup evidence.
analysis.null_result: A valid null, mixed, or regressed result is publishable and must not trigger task replacement or scorer tuning.

readiness.execution_gate: No comparison spec, source lock, task image, preview, approval, or paid cell may be generated until a completed V2 bundle validates and a prospective power receipt passes.

claim_boundary: This V2 artifact is a prospective protocol, not evidence. It authorizes no GitHub acquisition, task authoring, model call, spend, behavioral claim, conference claim, or community-wide conclusion.
not_generated: source locks, task images, previews, approvals, results, or reports
